prompt:
You have a compound library with structural and activity data. Identify activity cliffs in this dataset and characterise the compound most central to cliff relationships.

Columns: Compound_ID, SMILES, pIC50, Series

Store:
- `cliff_hub` (str): Compound_ID of the compound involved in the most cliff pairs

Load data from _TASK_INPUT['file_path'].

metadata.notes: Tier 3 — requires pairwise Tanimoto computation over ~200 compounds; agents must correctly define and enumerate activity cliffs.
